about: The named regions of the real app captures in public/screens, measured on the captures themselves (capture px, 1080 x 2346), for the covers' "detail" and "phone" compositions (src/cover/layout.mjs; round 3, 27 Oct). Each region: "for" the categories whose claim it proves (the 27 Oct judges: the car-value card on a parking cover, an in-app row on a widgets cover; the brief offers a region only to these), "element" [x, y, w, h] the whole UI element (a "detail" draws it WHOLE, never cut: the owner's never-crop rule), "strip" [x, y, w, h] the part of its own screen a "detail" shows round it (the lock screen's wallpaper, the map: so it reads as a real screen in the tile, not as a white card; it holds the element whole), "box" what older tools read (the element), "radius" the element's corner radius, "key" [x, y, w, h] the short value or 2-3 words that prove the headline, "keyPx" its font size in capture px (its digits' cap height / 0.69), "text" the key as it reads, "keyRoom" [top, right, bottom, left] the free capture px round the key (a hand ring or underline that would run into the screen's own words is left out); for "phone" also "label" (the row's title), "sub" (its grey line) and "icon" [x, y, w, h] the row's own icon (drawn from the capture's pixels, 1.6x at most), as they read on the capture. COVER_ZOOM: a "detail" draws its strip at most 940 px wide and 1.6x (src/cover/layout.mjs SHARP), so its key must still be 96 px (80 for a key of digits or Latin capitals, as tall as Mkhedruli at 96): keyPx x (940 / strip width) >= that. Smaller app text goes on a "phone" row, set as type. Add a region only after measuring it on the capture, and only on a capture verified against the current app (screens.json).
